Actual composed lower-only source for [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (Errata)]] from page 1 of [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-October-2021-capture.pdf]], known by the 5 October 2021 archive capture. Rendered from the unchanged PDF at the saved image rectangle with matrix 745 divided by its width, alpha=False; vectors and icons remain the source’s own. It prints the pilot icon followed by 3, uppercase If, suspended, a dotted bottom label and no errata mark. No upper face or artwork is reconstructed. [[Category:Card images]]
